UserMemory.title: UserMemory
UserMemory.description: Cross-session memory profile and creative preferences summarized by the AI.

userId.description: Unique identifier for the user profile.

summary.description: Overall natural language memory summary of the user.

facts.description: Key factual preferences and creative notes remembered about the user.

sessionCount.description: Total number of completed voice sessions.

lastSessionEnd.description: Timestamp when the last session concluded.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last memory update.

MemoryItem.title: MemoryItem
MemoryItem.description: An individual granular memory fact or preference that the user can view, edit, or delete.

id.description: Unique ID of the memory item.

text.description: The exact fact or preference text.

updatedAt.description: When this memory was last modified.

/user_memories/{userId}.description: Cross-session consolidated memory document for the user.

/user_memories/{userId}/items/{itemId}.description: Granular individual memory items that can be transparently managed.
